200.description: WAV audio, sent as VOICEVOX generates it. A failure after the body has started closes the connection early.

AnalyzeItem.description: Analyze-only G2P result. Validate / Synthesis keep [`G2pItem`].

dictionary_words.description:
Spoken-word indexes actually taken from a user dictionary.

`[]` means tracking succeeded and no dictionary word was used.
`null` means tracking was incomplete. The field is required.

schema_version.description: `"2"`（省略時）または `"3"`。v3 の kana は word ごとに `表記:読み` を持つ。

MigrateRequest.description: schema v2 の item を v3 にする。再解析で割り当てた表記を付けるだけで、読み・核・境界は変えない。

wav_base64.description: 16-bit PCM の WAV（チャンネル数とサンプリング周波数は問わない）を base64 にしたもの。

aligner_version.description: アライナのモデルと前処理の版。変わったら呼び出し側のキャッシュを作り直す。

moras.description: kana のモーラ順に1つずつ。

score.description: アライメントの全トークンの事後確率の平均（0〜1）。読み違いの判定には使えない。

ProsodyMora.description: One mora of the reference recording, in seconds from the start of the audio.

log_f0.description:
Median natural log of F0 (Hz) over voiced frames in `vowel_start..end`. `null` when fewer
than two frames are voiced.

vowel_start.description: Same as `start` for a mora without a consonant (vowel, `ン`, `ッ`, `ー`).

ProsodyPause.description:
Silence after a phrase (not after the last phrase): always after a `、` `？` `！` phrase, and
after a `/` phrase when the reference pauses there for at least `MIN_PHRASE_PAUSE_SEC`.

after_mora.description: 0-based index of the last mora of the phrase.

pitch_range_weight.description:
How much of the reference pitch range survives: 0 maps the reference contour onto the
engine's own range (z-normalized), 1 keeps the reference range in log F0. VoiSona ignores it.

pitch_weight.description: 0 keeps the engine pitch, 1 follows the reference. VoiSona ignores it.

timing_weight.description: 0 keeps the engine durations, 1 follows the reference rhythm.

schema_version.description: `"2"`（省略時）または `"3"`。v3 は原文を再解析せず、表記と原文を文字列で照合する。

VoicevoxStreamingSynthesisRequest.description: `/v1/synthesis/voicevox` の request に VOICEVOX `/streaming_synthesis` の `segment_length` を足したもの。

prosody.description: 参照音声の韻律（`POST /v1/prosody/extract` の結果と重み）。省略すると今までどおり合成する。

segment_length.description: 一度に合成する音声の秒数。省略時は VOICEVOX の既定値（0.26.0 では 0.3）。
